{{Quote|Hey, what did we get this time?"'' <br /> ''"Usual stuff."'' <br /> ''"What about that mag-sealed crate?"'' <br /> ''"Eh, someone said it was some kind of Jedi artifact. Kaerobani's having it transferred to his private collection on the planet.|One Lumini pirate to another after a frigate dropped off pillaged goods.|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The '''Orbiting Ship Yards''' served as a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] for the [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini pirates]], circling the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]]. The [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] housed the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate's]] large collection of ships including [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[R-41 Starchaser]]s, [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tugs]], and two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Delta-class DX-9 transports]] among others across its many [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. [[Kaerobani]]'s crew sorted through loot from raids and organized for raids. To assist with inventory, [[Imperial loader droid|loader droids]] moved heavy cargo if a [[lifting claw]] was unavailable, while [[Mark IV sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] patrolled the station.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[File:KaeroPirates.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lumini pirates onboard the Orbiting Ship Yards.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the Lumini pirates deployed their [[Lumini pirates' Interdictor cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] and [[Lumini pirates' Nebulon-B frigate|Nebulon-B frigate]] to pull a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and attack. The boarding crew [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the crew and stole their supplies, including a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|holocron]]. Unbeknownst to the pirates, New Republic [[Agent/Legends|agent]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] snuck aboard in a cargo crate before the pirate force jumped away. Back above Rathalay, Tugs moved the stolen goods from the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to the station, including Jade's, while a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] circled the platform as additional support during the unloading process. Jade followed the [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]] and slipped aboard a transport headed from the Orbiting Ship Yards to [[Kaerobani's base]] on the planet.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The dread pirate Kaerobani (and that's me being clever with the word Caribbean) steals a Sith holocron and Mara has to chase him to his hideout.|Game developer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]]|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The Orbiting Ship Yards appeared in [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> The publisher, [[LucasArts]], first identified the station in a webpage advertising the games new features days before the game's release.<ref name="Features">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref>
